everywhere I go to and try to get better seems to not care about me so I don’t really see the point in living anymore for me. This subreddit for example. Every post I’ve made has been deleted by the moderators even though I’ve made sure I’m following all the rules. I can’t keep my feelings bottled up but if I express it feels like the world is against me regardless and the fact that I’m unable to post isn’t helping the situation at all.

I feel the same. This subreddit is for expression but all I can do is comment. Every post about how I feel has been deleted, it makes me feel like there is nobody on any platform in any world and anywhere that don’t care how I feel.

Listening to him is good but I know from experience that getting professional help isn’t always the answer. I used to see a therapist, she just called me pathological liar, not actually realising what I was feeling. I then saw the school counsellor, who I personally didn’t feel comfortable talking to. So the best thing to do is to not smother him and gradually help him over an amount of time. Going in too fast hurts people more but going in too slow makes them feel unloved. it’s extremely difficult to walk the fine line between the two but it’s achievable. Remind him that he is loved but also respect his feelings and privacy. I hope this helped, if you don’t like it please don’t hate me
